bends.note: Reading Road runs ENE (slope ~-0.35) from the Pendleton corner, then curves to run NE (slope ~-1.28) toward Dandridge; centreline angle point

ends.note: runs to the NW line of Reading Road at the NE sheet edge; the centreline crossing with Reading Road (~x 4055) is off the sheet

notes: Pendleton is the west edge; its west kerb is off the drawn sheet, so its centre (x~285) is taken from the east block line (~377, 60 ft) and the water pipe (~292). Pendleton/Reading Road is not listed: Reading's centreline at Pendleton (~y 4605) falls just below the paper edge (~4597); sheet 148 has it. Liberty is ~54 ft between the 158 outline and the 154 block fronts (50' printed). Streets north of Liberty are 158 outlines angled NNE: Young (printed 'YOUNG'), a narrow ~20 ft street at x~2500 and a 50 ft street with water pipe at x~3350. The last two are not named on this sheet; from the key map (HIRAM and HIGHLAND reach Liberty along the 158 frontage, in that order) they are named Hiram Street and Highland Avenue (key map prints only 'HIRAM' and 'HIGHLAND'; check). About 58 px east of Hiram (not in line with it, so Hiram/Liberty is a T) an unnamed passage (10 ft at Liberty, 20 ft and 15 ft further south, beside a 13 ft retaining wall) runs south to Dandridge; it is listed under alleys, and Schenck Alley ends at it (~2490,1292). The area east of the passage between Liberty and Dandridge is covered by sheet 160. Dandridge is 40 ft west of Frank and printed 32'6" east of Frank. NOAH ALLEY ('ALLEY' label) runs from Pendleton across Frank to Reading Road (the part east of Frank is unlabelled but in line). East 13th is printed 'E. 13TH (WOODWARD)' and East 12th 'E. 12TH (ABIGAIL)'; 'ANNA ALLEY' (10 ft) is in line with Bodley Alley west of Pendleton on sheet 148, so Pendleton/Anna Alley is a cross. Frank runs only Dandridge to East 13th. Widdell Alley (printed 'WIDDELL AL.', 10 ft) runs East 12th to Dodt Alley. Dodt Alley (10 ft) runs ENE from Pendleton to an unnamed 10 ft N-S alley from East 12th at x~1499; a pasted strip continues it ENE to about (1800,3620), where it appears to end at the planing mill (uncertain). Reading Road crossings were re-measured from both sides: the NW block line and the SE outline line (149/155) are both drawn along the NE stretch, ~70 ft apart; points are midway.
